scripts.check: node -e "const{readdirSync}=require('fs');const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');let bad=0;for(const d of ['js','scripts','test'])for(const f of readdirSync(d).filter(x=>/\.(js|mjs)$/.test(x))){try{execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',`${d}/${f}`]);}catch{bad++;console.error('语法错误:',`${d}/${f}`);}}process.exit(bad?1:0)"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run fuzz && npm run selftest
